text:
marc: FYI published @redwood/js-sdk 2.3.1 — several customers on edge runtimes reporting SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'export' when importing the SDK. Anyone else seeing this?

jen: Can you paste the error stack and what environment? Next.js edge? Cloudflare?

marc: Stack (snippet):
```
SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'export'
    at Object.<anonymous> (node:internal/modules/cjs/loader: — /workspace/node_modules/@redwood/js-sdk/dist/index.mjs:1:1)
```
Edge runtime (Vercel Edge + Cloudflare Workers reports). Appears during SSR import.

ci-bot: CI alert — publish job passed but `npm pack` for the tarball shows missing files: dist/index.mjs and dist/index.mjs.map not included. rsync exclude pattern in release script skipped `*.mjs`.

eli: Looks like package.json `exports` is pointing to `./dist/index.mjs` for import, but the published package only has `index.cjs` and no sourcemaps. Rollup output probably didn't produce the .mjs variant. Check rollup config and `output.format`.

marc: Confirmed. release script uses `rollup -c` twice but second run writes to `dist/index.cjs` and we unintentionally excluded `dist/*.mjs` in `release:copy` step. Also `types` and `.d.ts.map` missing.

sophie: Ugh. How bad is the customer impact? Workarounds?

marc: Workaround: consumer can `import pkg from '@redwood/js-sdk/dist/index.cjs'` or downgrade to 2.3.0. Hotfix plan: cut 2.3.2 patch that includes `.mjs`, maps, and correct `exports`. Add a CI check that `npm pack` contains entries from `exports`.

jen: Can you add the quick PR + cherry-pick? I'll prepare the publish pipeline rollback and alert support to message affected customers with downgrade instructions.

marc: PR open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/842 — fixes rsync exclude, adds `ci:validate-pack` job.

ci-bot: Noted — created issue #1093 to add `pack-validation` to release workflow.

sophie: Also add a note in changelog about ESM/CJS parity and edge runtime testing. :memo:

jen: Also add a post-release smoke test on Vercel Edge using the example app. If it passes, close the incident.

marc: Will do. Target patch publish in next 30m. Thanks all. :pray:

jen: closing — let us know when patch is out.

marc: 2.3.2 published, confirms artifact contains `index.mjs`, `index.cjs`, `.map` and `types`. rolling deploy now.
